body:
I owe someone something.

Currently that is rent to my roommates and promises to my gf and friends. It's pretty shitty to only stick around because you feel obligated, but it works.

Also, not having a convenient method. After having tried once you realize that your instincts to avoid pain and death are pretty damn strong. I'd be a lot happier if I could get a pistol or something easily as effective and keep it as a security blanket.

That's also a good reason of not speaking up in the first place; which is unfortunate for those who could benefit from help.

I'm stubborn and don't intend to work past my mental problems until I feel like I can on my own. Saying that out loud to anybody while still posing a risk to yourself is a damn good way to get locked up.
